description: This file defines the MetasploitOutputProcessor class, which processes XML output files from Metasploit, extracting host and vulnerability data into application models.

classes.name: MetasploitOutputProcessor
classes.description: A class that processes Metasploit XML output files to extract host vulnerabilities and converts them into internal data models.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes a given XML file path, parses the XML, extracts vulnerabilities associated with hosts, and returns a ProcessorResult object containing vulnerabilities.
